title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
description: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

items.content_html:
An incorrect check in the JP2 will result in an heap buffer over-write of a single byte when specifying certain options.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-533m-3wf6-c33v
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-533m-3wf6-c33v
